targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", MAX(block_number)::bigint AS value FROM meta.chain_head;
SELECT now() AS "time", MAX(block_number)::bigint AS value FROM meta.processed_head;
SELECT now() AS "time", ( (SELECT MAX(block_number) FROM meta.chain_head) - (SELECT MAX(block_number) FROM meta.processed_head) )::bigint AS value;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname ~ '^0x';
SELECT ts AS "time", block_number::bigint AS "Chain head" FROM meta.chain_head WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours' ORDER BY ts;
SELECT ts AS "time", block_number::bigint AS "Processed head" FROM meta.processed_head WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours' ORDER BY ts;
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS "time", (MAX(block_number) - MIN(block_number))::bigint AS "Blocks/min" FROM meta.processed_head WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT table_name, rows
FROM world_api_metrics.table_counts
WHERE table_name LIKE 'world_api_dlt.%'
  AND ( split_part(table_name,'.',2) LIKE 'raw_%'
        OR split_part(table_name,'.',2) IN ('smartassembly','smartassembly_flat','smartcharacter','killmails','solarsystem','type','tribe','tribe_member') )
ORDER BY table_name;
SELECT now() AS "time", SUM(rows)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_metrics.table_counts;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_solarsystems;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_types;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_tribes;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details__smart_assemblies;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly_flat;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly;
SELECT now() AS "time", COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.killmails),0)::bigint AS value;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.solarsystem;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.tribe;
SELECT now() AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM world_api_dlt.tribe_member;

SELECT split_part(table_name,'.',1) AS schema, split_part(table_name,'.',2) AS table_name, rows FROM world_api_metrics.table_counts WHERE table_name LIKE 'world_api_dlt.%' AND split_part(table_name,'.',2) NOT LIKE 'raw_%' AND split_part(table_name,'.',2) NOT LIKE '_%' AND split_part(table_name,'.',2) <> 'smartassembly_flat' ORDER BY rows DESC, table_name;

SELECT schema, table_name, COALESCE(rows,0) AS rows, last_ingest_at, ROUND(minutes_since_ingest::numeric,2) AS minutes_since_ingest, expected_cadence_min, last_heartbeat, ROUND(minutes_since_heartbeat::numeric,2) AS minutes_since_heartbeat, job_ok, status FROM world_api_dlt.worldapi_ingest_health ORDER BY table_name;

-- Per-table last load id/time for DLT tables with age in minutes.
-- Uses each table's _dlt_load_id joined to _dlt_loads.inserted_at (canonical + raw).
WITH loads AS (
  -- raw/* sources
  SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_solarsystems' AS table_name, MAX(_dlt_load_id) AS last_load_id FROM world_api_dlt.raw_solarsystems
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_types',        MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.raw_types
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_tribes',       MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.raw_tribes
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters', MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details', MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details
  -- nested array does not carry _dlt_load_id; derive via parent details rows
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details__smart_assemblies', MAX(d._dlt_load_id)
             FROM world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details d
             JOIN world_api_dlt.raw_smartcharacters_details__smart_assemblies a
               ON a._dlt_parent_id = d._dlt_id
  -- canonical / normalized / flattened tables
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.smartassembly',       MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.smartcharacter',      MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.smartcharacter
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.smartassembly_flat',  MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly_flat
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.solarsystem',         MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.solarsystem
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.tribe',               MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.tribe
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.type',                MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.type
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.tribe_member',        MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.tribe_member
  -- events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'world_api_dlt.killmails',           MAX(_dlt_load_id) FROM world_api_dlt.killmails
), joined AS (
  SELECT l.table_name, l.last_load_id, ld.inserted_at AS loaded_at
  FROM loads l
  LEFT JOIN world_api_dlt._dlt_loads ld ON ld.load_id = l.last_load_id
)
SELECT table_name, last_load_id, loaded_at,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - loaded_at)) / 60.0 AS age_min
FROM joined
ORDER BY age_min NULLS LAST, table_name;

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'killmails' AS table_name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS rows FROM world_api_dlt.killmails
  UNION ALL SELECT 'smartassembly', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'smartassembly_flat', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly_flat
  UNION ALL SELECT 'smartcharacter', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.smartcharacter
  UNION ALL SELECT 'solarsystem', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.solarsystem
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tribe', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.tribe
  UNION ALL SELECT 'type', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.type
  UNION ALL SELECT 'tribe_member', COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.tribe_member
) t
ORDER BY table_name;

SELECT now() AS "time",
  CASE WHEN flat_ct = 0 THEN 0::float
       ELSE (asm_ct::float / flat_ct::float) * 100.0 END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly) AS asm_ct,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM world_api_dlt.smartassembly_flat) AS flat_ct
) s;

SELECT date_trunc('hour', inserted_at) AS "time", COUNT(*)::bigint AS "DLT loads"
FROM world_api_dlt._dlt_loads
WHERE $__timeFilter(inserted_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
SELECT schemaname AS namespace, relname AS table_name, n_live_tup::bigint AS rows FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname ~ '^0x' ORDER BY rows DESC, namespace, table_name LIMIT 200;
